scenes.title: Miso Soup and Bail Sales
scenes.summary: While Kuroki debates censorship and natural beauty on television, Muranishi savors homemade miso soup at the office and learns how his hundred-million-yen bail was funded.

scenes.title: Reunion at the Disco
scenes.summary: At a packed Tokyo disco celebrating his release, Muranishi hears that Kuroki officially left university and sincerely thanks Kawada for holding the team together.

scenes.title: Turning Down One Billion Yen
scenes.summary: Over late-night noodles, Ikezawa offers one billion yen to acquire Muranishi's company and control distribution, and Muranishi flatly refuses to work under him.

scenes.title: Poseidon Changes Course
scenes.summary: Ikezawa lifts retail sanctions, pivots Poseidon toward real-action productions, and orders Furuya to take a smaller cut while halting Muranishi's underground tapes.

scenes.title: Fifteen Videos in Five Days
scenes.summary: With aspiring actresses lining up to follow Kuroki, Muranishi packs their shooting schedule and promotes a young crewman to director while Kaede scales up Poseidon's output.

scenes.title: Words Are My Weapon
scenes.summary: Muranishi uses vivid spoken encouragement behind the camera to spark unscripted energy, and the video chain Proprietor tells Kawada they pushed the industry king into overdrive.

scenes.title: Queen of Late-Night Television
scenes.summary: In the dressing room, Kuroki admits she wants to act in Muranishi's films again before charming a roaring television studio audience with her witty poise.
scenes.location: television dressing room and studio stage

scenes.title: A Stolen Master Tape
scenes.summary: A former actress arrives in tears after an uncensored pirated tape forced her to quit her office job, prompting Muranishi to demand who stole their raw footage.

scenes.title: Stop Selling Them Immediately
scenes.summary: Toshi admits that half of Muranishi's bail came from selling uncensored master tapes underground, and Muranishi bows his head begging Toshi to stop the sales at once.

scenes.title: No Turning Back With Furuya
scenes.summary: When Toshi visits Furuya to pull out of the underground business, Furuya hands him the hideout, demands Kuroki's master tape, and warns him there is no turning back.

scenes.title: Severance Money at Night
scenes.summary: Kawada catches Toshi ransacking the office at night for master tapes, spots needle marks on his arm, and tries to buy him out before Muranishi stops their fight.

scenes.title: Go Back to Hokkaido
scenes.summary: Grief-stricken that Toshi ruined himself for his sake, Muranishi orders Toshi to return to Hokkaido and ends their partnership despite Toshi's desperate pleas.

scenes.title: Citywide Crackdown Before the New Era
scenes.summary: With the emperor in critical condition, Tokyo police leaders launch a massive sweep against crime groups and warn detective Takei to clean up his own territory.

scenes.title: Creating a New Era Together
scenes.summary: Over holiday cake, Muranishi and Kuroki confess they want to film together again, and Kuroki inspires Muranishi to bare his true self openly before the public.

scenes.title: Baring Everything on Television
scenes.summary: While Ikezawa boasts to Takei about Poseidon's booming sales, Muranishi appears in white briefs beside Kuroki on television and sparks long lines at video shops.
scenes.location: jazz club, television studio, and restaurant

scenes.title: The Fall of a King and End of an Era
scenes.summary: Police raid Toshi's underground ring and arrest Ikezawa for obscenity just as the imperial era ends, while Takei warns Muranishi never to touch underground tapes.

scenes.title: Witnessing a Miracle in the New Era
scenes.summary: In the new era, Toshi joins Furuya's yakuza family after prison while Muranishi buys a whole building, predicts satellite broadcasts from the sky, and films again with Kuroki.
scenes.location: new company building and studio set
